title: Matching transforms do not prove evaluated geometry
environment: Unity 2022.3.22f1/Blender 5.2.1, depth-one MeshRenderer and supported FBX settings. Point-set parity is not topology, Skin or general FBX-frame equivalence.
goal: Place directly referenced mesh resources in nested occurrences.
approach: Historical failed assumption: The native FBX object transform was assumed to belong to the directly referenced mesh subasset.
what_worked: Historical correction: Apply the independently verified mesh frame, excluding Model translation, only when exact receipts/revisions and supported importer settings validate. Verification reported by the source: An asymmetric four-point probe isolated basis/unit conversion. Corrected normal import and rename/resolve/reopen stayed within 1e-5; omitted scale, doubled Model transform and omitted instance transform controls failed.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: Transform checks passed while evaluated world-point errors exceeded 3.6 units in a public fixture.
why: Confirmed for the fixture: importer file scale applied to mesh coordinates, but the FBX Model-node translation did not belong to that direct mesh frame.
improved_method: Verify evaluated world geometry independently of transform matrices. Distinguish resource-local coordinates from scene-node placement before applying either.
when_to_use: Unity 2022.3.22f1/Blender 5.2.1, depth-one MeshRenderer and supported FBX settings. Point-set parity is not topology, Skin or general FBX-frame equivalence.
when_not_to_use: Point-set parity is not topology, Skin or general FBX-frame equivalence.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
